question_plain: Your request can be read in two ways. A: the design covers the sales unit only. B: it covers sales and customer service together. Which is your request?
question_original: Frame scope, item 3: two independent drafts read the Design Request differently and the cited passages do not settle it (difference DIF-4).

asking_form.decision: Which reading of the request is the scope of this design

why_it_matters: The scope decides which parts are designed.
effect_of_answer: Fixes the scope row of the frame.

minimality_proof.why_unanswered: The articles state objects of the company, not the purpose as the organisation wants it stated in the operating model.
